Academic Research

AI (Mis)attribution: Perceiver Expectations About Agent Origin as a Driver of Social Evaluations in Text-Based Interactions

An online experiment asking whether people judge the same interaction differently when they believe artificial intelligence is involved.

Main finding: Participants rated the conversation as more natural when they believed both speakers were human, even though the transcript was unchanged.
